_header: FROZEN CALIBRATION PARAMETER SET. This is the parameter set behind every reported sweep in the manuscript and in Online Resource 1. It is a verbatim copy of the params block of runs/batch_v2_3_search_20260213_043518/summary/BEST_PARAMS.json, which is the default --best argument of scripts/run_v2_7_endogenous_delta_sweep.py. The runs/ tree is gitignored, so this file exists to make the parameter set committable alongside the results it produced. See BEST_PARAMS_frozen.README.md for the empirical verification.
_verification: All seven values were confirmed by bit-for-bit replay of committed runs against the frozen v2.7 source. See BEST_PARAMS_frozen.README.md.
_params_note: load_best_params() reads only seven of these eight keys: membership_benefit, membership_benefit_threat, exit_opportunity_threat_coeff, exit_block_exponent, exit_commit_steps, exit_cost, shock_strength. The eighth key, exit_opportunity_base, is NOT read from this file; the driver passes its own --base-opp value, which is 0.30 in every reported sweep. The value 0.2381166236911743 recorded here is inert.
